payload.title: File:Venetoraptor (holotype).png
payload.credit_html: Modified from Figure 2 of "Triassic pterosaur precursors of Brazil: catalog, evolutionary context, and a new hypothesis for phylogenetic relationships of Pterosauromorpha"
payload.description_html: a) rigorous skeletal reconstruction of Venetoraptor gassenae. b) posterior half of the skull in lateral view. c) articulated caudal vertebrae and chevrons in lateral view. d) femur in posterior view. e) premaxilla in lateral view. f) anterior end of the dentary in lateral view (reversed). g) articulated forearm and metacarpus in lateral view. h) articulated partial pes in lateral view.
